overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works held a brief meeting in which two claims were acted upon: a claim from Wayne Becker for $262.50 was denied, and a claim from Vicky Swanson for $1,290.83 was approved. The meeting was very short, with no extended discussion or public comment recorded in the transcript.

discussions.body: A motion was made to deny the claim submitted by Wayne Becker in the amount of $262.50. The motion was seconded and approved by the board. No discussion or debate was recorded in the transcript prior to the vote.

A motion was made to approve the claim submitted by Vicky Swanson in the amount of $1,290.83. The motion was seconded and approved by the board. No discussion or debate was recorded in the transcript prior to the vote.
